prompt:
The section sections/lookbook-wrapped.liquid renders a lookbook grid. It has several optional wrapper elements:
- a div.page-width wrapper that is output only when section.settings.full_width is false;
- an <a> wrapper around each image, output only when block.settings.link is set;
- a <figcaption>, output only when block.settings.caption is set.

The grid column count comes from section.settings.columns. The markup is correct, so do not change it. The {% schema %} JSON is outdated: it lacks the full_width and columns settings and uses wrong block setting types.

Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following, with keys in this order:

1. "name": "Lookbook"
2. "tag": "section"
3. "class": "section-lookbook"
4. "settings", in this order:
   - {"type": "text", "id": "title", "label": "Title", "default": "The lookbook"}
   - {"type": "checkbox", "id": "full_width", "label": "Full width", "default": false}. The default is the JSON boolean false, so the page-width wrapper is shown by default.
   - {"type": "range", "id": "columns", "label": "Columns", "min": 1, "max": 4, "step": 1, "default": 3}. All numbers must be JSON integers.
5. "blocks": one block type {"type": "look", "name": "Look", "settings": [...]}. Its settings are, in this order:
   - {"type": "image_picker", "id": "image", "label": "Image"}
   - {"type": "url", "id": "link", "label": "Link"}
   - {"type": "inline_richtext", "id": "caption", "label": "Caption"}
   None of these three settings has a default, so the optional link and caption wrappers are absent until the merchant fills them in.
6. "max_blocks": 8 (an integer)
7. "presets": [{"name": "Lookbook", "blocks": [{"type": "look"}, {"type": "look"}, {"type": "look"}]}]

Do not add any other keys. The file must keep exactly one top-level schema block. Change only sections/lookbook-wrapped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
